facts.raw_span: A 57-year-old woman
eight episodes of hemobilia treated with TAE
progressive enlargement of the right‐lobe mass
no history of liver disease, including hepatolithiasis
vital signs were stable
hemoglobin 11.1 g/dL
alkaline phosphatase 819 IU/L
CA19-9 was 862 U/mL
a 10 × 15 cm multilocular oval mass with papillary infoldings in the right hepatic lobe
obstruction of the right hepatic bile duct, compression of the left hepatic duct, and dilation of peripheral bile ducts
papillary adenocarcinoma in situ or papillary adenoma with severe atypia
a liver edge palpable four fingerbreadths below the xiphoid process
